project.title: Bharatanatyam Heritage
project.purpose: Generate a consistent set of Bharatanatyam heritage images and a short cinematic image-to-video sequence.

visual_consistency.dancer_identity: Keep the same adult Indian Bharatanatyam dancer, facial features, hairstyle, makeup, jewelry, and costume across all images and video shots.
visual_consistency.costume: Traditional vibrant red and gold silk Bharatanatyam costume with pleated fan, temple jewelry, gold waist belt, jhumka earrings, ankle bells (salangai), jasmine flowers, and a decorated bun.
visual_consistency.heritage_setting: Ancient Tamil Nadu Dravidian temple courtyard with carved granite pillars, stone flooring, brass kuthu vilakku lamps, and a sacred cultural atmosphere.
visual_consistency.quality: Photorealistic, cinematic, highly detailed, anatomically accurate, authentic classical dance styling.

image_prompts.title: Divine Dance Pose

SCALE.Subject: A graceful adult Indian Bharatanatyam classical dancer representing the rich cultural heritage of Tamil Nadu. She wears a traditional vibrant red and gold silk Bharatanatyam costume with a beautifully arranged pleated fan, exquisite temple jewelry, golden jhumka earrings, an elegant temple necklace, a traditional waist belt, ankle bells (salangai), jasmine flowers adorning her hair, and a decorated bun. Traditional Bharatanatyam makeup with expressive eyes.
SCALE.Composition: Full-body cinematic portrait with the dancer centered in the frame. Her body is balanced in authentic Aramandi posture, knees bent, feet turned outward, and hands held in a classical mudra. The costume pleats are clearly visible. A majestic Dravidian temple with carved stone pillars and a Nataraja sculpture forms the background. Symmetrical framing, realistic proportions, visual depth, and detailed textures.
SCALE.Action: The dancer holds a poised traditional Bharatanatyam opening stance with a calm devotional expression, elegant hand mudras, and a sense of readiness for rhythmic performance.
SCALE.Location: An ancient Tamil Nadu temple courtyard inspired by the heritage temples of Thanjavur and Chidambaram, featuring intricately carved granite pillars, stone flooring, brass oil lamps, and sacred architectural details.
SCALE.Esthetic: Ultra-realistic Indian cultural photography, rich red and gold palette, warm golden temple lighting, soft sunlight rays, intricate silk and jewelry textures, devotional and majestic mood, professional cinematic photography, 8K detail.

image_prompts.negative_prompt: Extra fingers, distorted hands, incorrect mudras, incorrect Aramandi posture, deformed anatomy, asymmetrical eyes, inconsistent face, modern clothing, inaccurate costume, floating jewelry, blurry details, low resolution, cartoon style, text, watermark, logo.

video_prompt.title: Bharatanatyam Heritage — 15-Second Cinematic Short
video_prompt.workflow: Image-to-video. Use the four generated images as visual references/keyframes in sequence. If the tool accepts only one reference image, use Image 1 as the primary reference and provide the remaining images as additional references where supported.

SCALE.Subject: The same adult Indian Bharatanatyam dancer shown in the reference images, wearing the exact same red and gold silk costume, temple jewelry, waist belt, salangai ankle bells, jasmine flowers, decorated bun, and traditional makeup. Preserve identity and costume continuity throughout the video.
SCALE.Composition: Vertical 9:16 cinematic video. Begin with a full-body wide shot in the temple courtyard, move into a medium shot highlighting abhinaya and mudras, capture a dynamic full-body classical dance pose, and finish with a centered full-body Namaskaram. Keep the dancer fully in frame during full-body shots and maintain stable visual continuity.
SCALE.Action: The dancer performs a short, graceful Bharatanatyam sequence: begins in a poised Aramandi opening stance, transitions into expressive abhinaya with precise hand mudras and eye movements, performs a controlled dynamic classical pose with rhythmic footwork, and concludes with a respectful Namaskaram. Movements must be fluid, physically plausible, and authentic to Bharatanatyam.
SCALE.Location: An ancient Tamil Nadu Dravidian temple courtyard inspired by Thanjavur and Chidambaram heritage architecture. Include carved granite pillars, stone flooring, brass kuthu vilakku lamps, and a subtle Nataraja sculpture in the background. Maintain the same location throughout.
SCALE.Esthetic: Photorealistic cinematic Indian heritage film, rich red and gold palette, warm golden-hour lighting, soft volumetric sun rays, highly detailed silk textures and temple jewelry, divine devotional mood, refined professional cinematography, 4K visual quality.

motion.camera_movement: Slow cinematic dolly-in at the opening, gentle stable lateral movement during the dance, subtle push-in for abhinaya, and a steady final framing for Namaskaram. Avoid fast orbiting or shaky camera movements.
motion.character_movement: Graceful Bharatanatyam movement with correct Aramandi posture, precise hand mudras, expressive eyes, natural rhythmic footwork, realistic costume pleat movement, and anatomically accurate transitions.
motion.environmental_movement: Brass oil lamps flicker gently, soft sunlight rays and dust particles remain subtle, jasmine flowers and silk fabric move naturally with the dancer.
motion.transitions: Smooth match cuts or gentle cinematic transitions between the provided reference poses. Preserve face, costume, jewelry, lighting, and temple setting.
motion.ending: Hold the final Namaskaram pose for a brief moment as warm golden light illuminates the dancer and temple courtyard.

audio.background_music: Original traditional South Indian Carnatic-inspired instrumental music featuring veena, flute, mridangam, and nattuvangam rhythmic syllables. Do not imitate a specific copyrighted recording.
audio.sound_effects: Subtle salangai ankle bells synchronized naturally with the dancer's footwork.

video_prompt.negative_prompt: Face morphing, identity changes, costume changes, jewelry changing shape, extra limbs, extra fingers, malformed hands, incorrect mudras, broken anatomy, unnatural dance movements, foot sliding, jitter, flicker, sudden camera jumps, shaky camera, excessive motion blur, background warping, distorted temple pillars, cartoon style, text artifacts, subtitles, watermark, logo.
